author: Mauritoo
body: My nickname is Mauritoo, I am banned for a st*pid guy, he said to a MOD that I used fastbow. It is not true, I never use a hack and I don't know what is fastbow... I want to get disbanned for this server, this is one of my favourites.

title: Error Ban

replies.author: _Nathy
replies.body:
Greetings Mauritoo, I am the mod that banned you.

Another Avicus user provided me with a video of you hacking,
that video can be found here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=98GqVCK-v_c&feature=youtu.be


From my point of view, I can observe you using the hack fastbow at about 1:13 and again at 1:29.

Until a Sr Mod delivers the final verdict I will put your appeal on review,


Regards,
Nathy

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Greetings, Mauritoo.

With the evidence we've been given we can make a final veredict on your appeal, which would be denying it due to the legitimacy the proof holds. Learn from your mistakes, hopefully a lesson is to be taught. Try appealing again in six months after your punishment was delivered.

Sincerely,
- timaeusTestified | Senior Moderator
